`abstract class Event`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`TweenEvent`](/reference/animation/tweenevent/), [`NodeEvent`](/reference/events/nodeevent/), [`UIEvent`](/reference/events/uievent/), [`ShortcutEvent`](/reference/ui/shortcutevent/), [`TaskEvent`](/reference/ui/taskevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Event.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/Event.java)

The base class of every event that a listener receives.

## Description

An event holds what happened: the node or the UI it concerns and the values of the change or of the input.
A listener of the priority [`EventPriority.MONITOR`](/reference/events/eventpriority/#EventPriority-value-MONITOR) receives it read-only: a subclass that changes its event, such as one that cancels or consumes it, calls `checkWritable` first.

## Method details

<a id="Event-method-monitor"></a>

### monitor

`void monitor(boolean monitor)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Marks the event read-only while the `MONITOR` listeners of an [`EventBus`](/reference/events/eventbus/) run, and writable again after them.
[`EventBus.fireMonitor`](/reference/events/eventbus/#EventBus-method-fireMonitor) calls it.

<a id="Event-method-checkWritable"></a>

### checkWritable

`void checkWritable(String verb)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: A MONITOR listener only reads …, it cannot call …(): listen with another priority to … it

Throws an `IllegalStateException` when a `MONITOR` listener receives the event.
Call it at the start of every method that changes the event; `verb` names that method in the message.
